entities.name: Mikołaj Zyblikiewicz
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mikołaj Zyblikiewicz was a Polish politician and lawyer of Ruthenian origin. He was the two-term Mayor of Kraków – in the then Grand Duchy of Kraków. A street in Kraków's Old Town is named in his memory, while his monument stands in front of the City Hall.
